actual_source_inspection: Read both complete Cambridge page-one search result sets in the live Chrome interface, at the exact query URLs in the bound record. Independently compared all 40 ordered shelfmarks, catalogue ranges and genre classifications. About 529 Genesis hits/27 pages and about 738 Psalms hits/37 pages are displayed estimates, not screened or independent-witness denominators.

Read both complete saved institutional TEI records and inspected both IIIF manifests and image service descriptions. Reconciled 4 Genesis and 8 Psalms canvas labels/dimensions with the TEI facsimile surfaces. TEI body page breaks do not provide a diplomatic transcription.

Viewed all four saved JPEGs: two whole-image derivatives and two source-native-scale regional derivatives. The model image display downsampled three of the four assets; the on-disk dimensions and source-region geometry were independently checked. No newly generated, enhanced or reconstructed image was used.

Genesis image 1r visibly carries handwritten 2a and the B6.24 object label. The right-column age/circumcision sequence and alternating Hebrew/Aramaic fit Genesis 17:24–26, supporting the report's local bridge to catalogue folio 2 rather than silently equating digital 1r with catalogue folio 1.

Psalms canvas 8/4v is a bifolium image: contextual text fits the end of Psalm 119 and start of Psalm 120 on one leaf, and the end of Psalm 135/start of Psalm 136 on the other. This is not a Psalm 145 locator or a nun-line presence/absence check. The regional image supports the 119/120 transition, not an uninterrupted transcription of the entire catalogue range.

Read the institutional image-use and metadata wording in both TEI/manifest packages. Metadata CC0 is not an image redistribution license; the report correctly retains private research handling and the publisher's public-web/publication contact requirement. This is source-policy reporting, not a legal opinion.
source_accuracy_findings: The 3 fuller-text research targets versus 37 records held outside an automatic continuous full-word lane is a sound classification of this convenience sample, not a collection census or a rejection of the latter records as all forms of evidence.
Commentary, translations, masora, exercises, liturgy and shorthand remain distinct from continuous Hebrew manuscript text. The Hebrew search filter alone does not establish language or textual genre.
Catalogue coverage ranges are not surviving-letter masks. The report appropriately holds Genesis 4:8, Psalm 22:17, Psalm 77:8 and Psalm 145 questions pending exact contextual image work.

The contradictory TEI columns attributes versus prose layouts are retained as metadata hazards. Physical leaves, bifolia, canvas count and shelfmarks are not collapsed into new independent manuscript counts.

The claimed native scale applies only to the two documented regional derivatives. The full/full downloads are explicitly server-resized, and advertised source dimensions are not claimed as the acquired whole-image dimensions.
